name: planning
description: Planning and tracking: create plans, update roadmap, archive completed plans.
when_to_use: Creating or updating plans, registering plans in roadmap, completing roadmap steps, roadmap entry management.
troubleshooting_tips: Use roadmap(operation="remove_entry") with a unique substring to avoid removing the wrong bullet.
When step references a plan file, prefer plan(operation="complete") so the plan is archived automatically.
